status: Proposed. Every value here is an illustrative default until Rex confirms it and it is fixed in the ratification contract for Block 0. After that, a value changes only by amendment (AMENDMENTS.md). No API route changes it.

batch.label: illustrative
batch.source: MASTER_SPEC Part C1: L1 contracts do not batch; they seal as soon as a jury rules

warmupMaxPct.label: illustrative
warmupMaxPct.source: MASTER_SPEC Part C1: value rule at warm-up no more than 10% of block cost (minRequestsForWarmup in packages/economics)

maxWaitSeconds.label: illustrative
maxWaitSeconds.source: MASTER_SPEC Part C1: the oldest funded contract waits at most 3,600 s

idleReserveUsd.label: illustrative
idleReserveUsd.source: Fixed cost per block for idle GPU hours, on top of warm-up. Zero until a proving operator measures idle time (Part D)

preset.label: illustrative
preset.source: packages/economics preset used to model a block: L2, FlashProve, unpacked

usdPerUnit.label: illustrative
usdPerUnit.source: Stablecoins counted at one US dollar when checking that the queue covers a block. Escrow in any other currency does not count toward the value rule until a price source is chosen

proofDeadlineSeconds.label: illustrative
proofDeadlineSeconds.source: MASTER_SPEC Part D1: after the reveal, each counted juror attaches its proof hash and uploads the proof before this deadline, or its vote is dropped and a no-proof fault is recorded against its bond

verifier.label: illustrative
verifier.source: The Verifier the devnet nodes run (packages/prove in verafyHarness). mock binds commitment, input and answer but is not a proof; deepprove and flashprove adapters exist behind the same interface

threshold.label: illustrative
threshold.source: Shares needed to open a queued contract: more than half the node set (2 of 3 on the devnet)

clockSkewSeconds.label: illustrative
clockSkewSeconds.source: How far ahead of its own clock a node lets the time rule run when it checks a close, the same skew it allows a block's time
